KNIFEHERO-STEALTH.title: Stealth
KNIFEHERO-STEALTH.description: Attacks against you are reduced to {Cap} damage. If you lose HP, or play an Attack, lose all Stealth and gain 1 Heat. Lose 1 Stealth at the end of your turn.
KNIFEHERO-STEALTH.smartDescription: Attacks against you are reduced to {Cap} damage. If you lose HP, or play an Attack, lose all Stealth and gain 1 Heat. Lose 1 Stealth at the end of your turn.
KNIFEHERO-CLOSETED.title: Closeted
KNIFEHERO-CLOSETED.description: At the start of your turn, discard a card to prevent the next damage you would take. If you can't, lose Closeted and add a Dazed to your hand. Playing an Attack removes all your Stealth and Closeted.
